slides.title: Future Works
textPreview: The remaining work · how we will close it out
•  Revalidate every pending application the moment fixes land in production so nothing re-tested remains open · while every open finding is Pending, the item is not considered closed.

•  Then close the two remaining coverage gaps · a security audit of the Jenkins CI/CD pipeline and a cloud security audit · so the delivery pipeline and the hosted estate hold the same standard as the applications we have already tested.

slides.title: Sophos Policies
textPreview: Block Python Application Across the Organization
-wide, with approved exceptions retained for developers and designated users in Marketing, RM, Operations Planning, Finance and CX.

The allow/block application list was reviewed and approved by Jimit. The base Application Control Policy and supporting allow/block policies are enabled; application activity is currently under monitoring.

slides.title: Ongoing Process
textPreview: We have compared the asset inventory against Sophos with ManageEngine reports and share the non-compliant agent status
Global exclusions have been backed up; 36 of 44 were identified as safe to remove. Test-team validation and final approval are pending.

slides.title: M365
textPreview: Security monitoring, investigation and access-control activities
Reviewed the activity of users flagged as risky and carried out the required follow-up actions. October review: 40 risky users
Two phishing emails were investigated. The sender domain and malicious URL were blocked, and delivered messages were soft-deleted from user mailboxes.

slides.title: Ongoing Process
textPreview: Policy governance and endpoint security controls
The policy remains in monitoring mode; CR-764 is awaiting approval.
Dedicated groups have been created for WhatsApp-only users, Development, Finance, HR, IT and Marketing to support department-specific DLP rules.
DLP Policy Violators  are identified based on the department and the rule is customised according to it.
Users have been added to exceptions based on the approved peripheral-control requirements.

slides.title: Future Work
textPreview: Upcoming security activities and planned assessments
The test phishing email has been sent.
Final approval from the team is awaited; once approval is received, the campaign is expected to take approximately 6–7 days to complete.
